title: On the Complete Feature Set for ADHD Classification in Children and Adolescents Based on EEG Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.27970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder is a neurodevelopmental condition that can affect attention, activity and impulse control. Electroencephalography (EEG) records brain activity as children and adolescents perform cognitive tasks. However, comparing features derived from these recordings requires consistent signal preparation, shared analysis windows and documented quality decisions. We curated 669 existing BALLADEER recordings from 156 participants across five task conditions so that researchers can compare seven EEG feature families on the same time intervals for each participant and task. The dataset links continuous signals to precomputed measurements from 115 feature definitions or templates and records the quality decisions made for each recording. translated_title: 基于脑电信号的儿童与青少年ADHD分类完整特征集研究
translated_abstract: 注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）是一种可能影响注意力、活动水平和冲动控制的神经发育性疾病。脑电图（EEG）可以在儿童和青少年执行认知任务时记录其大脑活动。然而，比较从这些记录中提取的特征需要一致的信号预处理、共享的分析时间窗口以及有据可查的质量决策。我们整理了来自156名参与者、涵盖五种任务条件的669条现有BALLADEER记录，使研究人员能够在相同的时间区间上，针对每位参与者和每项任务比较七个脑电特征族。该数据集将连续信号与来自115个特征定义或模板的预先计算测量值相关联，并记录了针对每条记录所做的质量决策。分析仍需考虑参与者内部的重复测量、残余伪迹以及不同采集系统之间的差异。技术验证涵盖了信号完整性（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文整理了一个包含156名参与者、669条记录的标准化脑电数据集，将连续信号与115种特征定义的预计算测量值相链接并记录质量决策，为儿童与青少年ADHD分类中七个脑电特征族的公平比较提供了统一基准。
en_tdlr: This paper curates a standardized EEG dataset of 669 recordings from 156 participants, linking continuous signals to precomputed measurements from 115 feature definitions with documented quality decisions, enabling fair comparison of seven EEG feature families for ADHD classification in children and adolescents.
